description: Technical SEO in Claude: GSC + crawl + DataForSEO - audit, market sizing, content recon.
name: io.github.houtini-ai/seo-audit-console

environmentVariables.description: Path to the Google service-account JSON key with Search Console access.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS

environmentVariables.description: Directory for per-property SQLite databases and reports. Defaults to ~/Documents/seo-audit-console.
environmentVariables.name: SAC_DATA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: DataForSEO API username (optional, enables SERP/keyword/domain/market/recon checks).
environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: TTL for the DataForSEO response cache, in days. Default 7.
environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_CACHE_DAYS

environmentVariables.description: Firecrawl API key (optional). Lets content recon scrape competitor pages. Get one at https://firecrawl.link/2d1PLD8
environmentVariables.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Supadata API key (optional). Lets content recon transcribe the ranking videos (YouTube/TikTok/X).
environmentVariables.name: SUPADATA_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Majestic API key (optional). Enriches link_intersect with Trust Flow + Topical Trust Flow and re-sorts prospects by real authority.
environmentVariables.name: MAJESTIC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: TTL for the Majestic response cache, in days. Default 30.
environmentVariables.name: MAJESTIC_CACHE_DAYS
